component.name: Showberry
component.summary: Browse and stream movies and TV series

description.p: Showberry is a modern movie and TV series streaming application for GNOME. It uses TMDB for movie and series metadata and supports multiple streaming providers with MPV playback.

ul.li: Browse trending and popular movies and series from TMDB
Search for any title with instant results
Stream movies and TV series using MPV with hardware acceleration
Torrent P2P streaming with background buffering and file selection
Filter and sort catalogues by genre, release year, language, and rating
Explore actor and director filmographies with complete credit timelines
Clean, adaptive GNOME interface with full keyboard navigation

screenshot.caption: Browse trending and popular movies with release info, filter & sort, and badges
Library view featuring continue watching progress and custom watchlist
Rich movie details with high-resolution backdrops, clickable director chip, cast, and overview
TV series catalogue with network badges and season counts
Season and episode picker with detailed synopsis and direct streaming
Actor and director filmography page with biography and work credits
Preferences dialog for custom TMDB keys, providers, and torrent caching

description.p: Comprehensive player UI redesign, libtorrent streaming, and packaging enhancements:

ul.li: Redesigned player controls and top bar with modern GNOME floating frosted glass capsules and backdrop blur
Integrated native libtorrent support for torrent streaming and metadata fetching
Refined badge pill styling and hover play action indicators
Added automatic TV series next episode countdown card and seamless autoplay
Added audio track selector with distinct headphones icon and audio track cycling shortcut (A)
Added variable playback speed popover and shortcuts ([ / ] for step adjustments, 0 / r to reset)
Added video fit / aspect ratio cycling shortcut (W) for Fit, Fill/Crop, 16:9, 21:9, and 4:3 modes
Added Next Episode hotkey (Shift+N)
Balanced overlay spacing with a 20px gap between Next Episode card and bottom controls

description.p: Playback UX enhancements, subtitle positioning, and caption controls:

ul.li: Suppressed On-Screen Controller (OSC) popups during keyboard seeking, volume, and playback shortcuts
Elevated subtitle rendering position with safe bottom clearance to avoid obscuring subtitles
Configured automatic English subtitle track selection on stream load
Added 'c' keyboard shortcut to toggle captions (defaulting to English)
Refined OSC styling with softened gradient and reduced bottom padding
Isolated background test threads to guarantee clean test runs in CI

description.p: Major feature release introducing advanced discovery filters, person filmographies, and UX refinements:

ul.li: Interactive Filter & Sort popover for Movies and Series with genre, decade/year, language, and vote count thresholds
New Person filmography page featuring actor/director biographies, formatted bio expansion, and categorized credit tabs
Clickable Director and Creator chips directly on Movie and TV details pages
Contextual release status badges including Upcoming, In Theaters, and Director chips
Full 4-way keyboard navigation support across PersonPage credits, tabs, and navigation views
Clean hover and click-outside popover dismissal for smoother browsing

description.p: Bugfix release restoring smooth keyboard navigation:

ul.li: Fixed Watchlist to Continue Watching and header tabs UP navigation
Fixed vertical column alignment when pressing DOWN in Movies and TV grids
Ensured smooth viewport scroll restoration when moving between sections
